import java.util.*;
import java.math.BigInteger;

public class Main {
    static final int MOD = 998244353;
    static final long MODFINAL = 1000000007L;
    static long[] pw10 = new long[17];
    static long n;
    static String n_str;

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextLong();
        n_str = Long.toString(n);

        pw10[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i < 17; ++i)
            pw10[i] = 10 * pw10[i - 1];

        BigInteger[] ans = new BigInteger[]{BigInteger.ZERO};

        // First part: numbers with prefix different from n_str
        for (int len = 1; len <= n_str.length(); ++len) {
            long cur = 0;
            StringBuilder curst = new StringBuilder();

            for (int firstdiff = 0; firstdiff < n_str.length() && firstdiff < len; ++firstdiff) {
                if (firstdiff > 0) {
                    cur = 10 * cur + (n_str.charAt(firstdiff - 1) - '0');
                    curst.append(n_str.charAt(firstdiff - 1));
                }

                for (int lastdig = 0; lastdig <= 9; ++lastdig) {
                    if (firstdiff == 0 && lastdig == 0)
                        continue;
                    if (lastdig == n_str.charAt(firstdiff) - '0')
                        continue;
                    if (len == n_str.length() && lastdig > n_str.charAt(firstdiff) - '0')
                        continue;

                    long curp = 10 * cur + lastdig;
                    String curstp = curst.toString() + (char)('0' + lastdig);

                    // compute base
                    long base = 0;
                    StringBuilder tmp = new StringBuilder();
                    for (int pos = 0; pos < curstp.length(); ++pos) {
                        char limit = curstp.charAt(pos);
                        for (char dig = (pos == 0 ? '1' : '0'); dig < limit; ++dig) {
                            base += count_with_prefix(tmp.toString() + dig, n, n_str);
                        }
                        tmp.append(limit);
                    }
                    base += len - 1;

                    // compute variables
                    List<Integer> variables = new ArrayList<>();
                    for (int pos = curstp.length(); pos < len; ++pos) {
                        variables.add((int)(count_with_prefix(tmp.toString() + '0', n, n_str) % MOD));
                        tmp.append('0');
                    }

                    base += 1;
                    base -= curp * pw10[len - curstp.length()];
                    for (int t = 0; t < variables.size(); ++t) {
                        int idx = variables.size() - 1 - t;
                        variables.set(idx, variables.get(idx) - (int)(pw10[t] % MOD));
                    }

                    base %= MOD;
                    if (base < 0)
                        base += MOD;

                    for (int i = 0; i < variables.size(); ++i) {
                        int val = variables.get(i) % MOD;
                        if (val < 0)
                            val += MOD;
                        variables.set(i, val);
                    }

                    solve(variables, (int)base, ans);
                }
            }
        }

        // Second part: numbers with prefix equal to n_str
        long cur = 0;
        StringBuilder curst = new StringBuilder();
        for (int len = 1; len <= n_str.length(); ++len) {
            curst.append(n_str.charAt(len - 1));
            cur = 10 * cur + (n_str.charAt(len - 1) - '0');

            long val = 1;
            StringBuilder tmp = new StringBuilder();
            for (int pos = 0; pos < curst.length(); ++pos) {
                char limit = curst.charAt(pos);
                for (char dig = (pos == 0 ? '1' : '0'); dig < limit; ++dig) {
                    val += count_with_prefix(tmp.toString() + dig, n, n_str);
                }
                tmp.append(limit);
            }
            val += len - 1;
            val -= cur;
            val %= MOD;
            if (val < 0)
                val += MOD;

            ans[0] = ans[0].add(BigInteger.valueOf(val));
        }

        ans[0] = ans[0].mod(BigInteger.valueOf(MODFINAL));
        System.out.println(ans[0].toString());
    }

    static long count_with_prefix(String s, long n, String n_str) {
        long ans = 0;
        long s_val = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < s.length(); ++i)
            s_val = 10 * s_val + (s.charAt(i) - '0');

        for (int len = s.length(); len <= n_str.length(); ++len) {
            if (len < n_str.length()) {
                ans += pw10[len - s.length()];
            } else {
                int cmp = s.compareTo(n_str.substring(0, s.length()));
                if (cmp < 0) {
                    ans += pw10[len - s.length()];
                } else if (cmp == 0) {
                    ans += (n + 1) - s_val * pw10[n_str.length() - s.length()];
                }
            }
        }
        return ans;
    }

    static void solve(List<Integer> variables, int base, BigInteger[] ans) {
        List<Integer> rem1 = new ArrayList<>();
        List<Integer> rem2;

        int[] cur = new int[]{base};
        int half = variables.size() / 2;
        brute(0, cur, half, variables, rem1);

        rem2 = rem1;
        rem1 = new ArrayList<>();
        cur[0] = 0;
        brute(half, cur, variables.size(), variables, rem1);

        Collections.sort(rem1);
        Collections.sort(rem2);

        long totalrsum = 0;
        for (int b : rem2)
            totalrsum += b;

        int j = rem2.size() - 1;
        for (int a : rem1) {
            while (j >= 0 && a + rem2.get(j) >= MOD)
                --j;

            long add = (long)a * rem2.size() + totalrsum - (long)(rem2.size() - 1 - j) * MOD;
            ans[0] = ans[0].add(BigInteger.valueOf(add));
        }
    }

    static void brute(int pos, int[] cur, int until, List<Integer> variables, List<Integer> rem) {
        if (pos == until) {
            rem.add(cur[0]);
            return;
        }

        int oldcur = cur[0];
        for (int t = 0; t < 10; ++t) {
            brute(pos + 1, cur, until, variables, rem);
            cur[0] = (cur[0] + variables.get(pos)) % MOD;
        }
        cur[0] = oldcur;
    }
}
